name: MisticEase – Video Thumbnails & Draggable Popups
author: MistiCuantum

sections.description:
Paste a video URL. Publish. Done.

Paste a YouTube (including Shorts) or Vimeo URL into a post or page. MisticEase turns it into a clickable thumbnail on the published page. Clicking the thumbnail opens the video in a popup. No shortcodes or embed code required.

What MisticEase does

  • Video popups you can move. On larger screens, visitors can drag a popup to another part of the page and continue watching while they read.
  • Image popups and galleries. Images linked to their media files open in popups, with previous and next navigation. If you use another image gallery plugin, you can use both together by turning off MisticEase’s image popup feature and floating mode in the settings panel.
  • Customize individual items. Change how individual items appear, such as displaying video titles as text links. See below for details.
  • Thumbnail caching. Saved thumbnails are served from your own site. Cache limits and automatic cleanup help prevent unused images from piling up.
  • Multisite support. Network administrators can manage thumbnail cache limits and CDN hostname settings across sites.

Try the live demo to use the popups yourself.

How thumbnail caching works

MisticEase retrieves and saves video thumbnails in the WordPress uploads directory. On the first view, a temporary lower-quality image or placeholder may appear while a high-quality thumbnail is being saved. Once saved, thumbnails are served from your own site. This avoids repeatedly retrieving the same thumbnails and helps reduce performance overhead.

Lazy loading is enabled by default. Cache limits can be configured, and automatic cleanup helps prevent unused thumbnails from piling up.

Video title links and Slash Markup

Put n/ directly before a video URL to show its title as a text link. Clicking the title opens the video popup. When writing it within a sentence, leave a space before n/ and after the URL, but no space between n/ and the URL.

Example: Watch n/https://youtu.be/XXXXXXXXXXX and keep reading.

To set the popup width to 980 px for a particular video or image, put p980/ before its URL. To set the thumbnail width to 300 px, use t300/. Combine them as t300/p980/URL to specify a 300 px thumbnail and a 980 px popup.

These simple prefixes are called Slash Markup and let you customize how individual items appear. Other options and detailed instructions are available in the Readme tab of the MisticEase settings panel. See the live demo for explanations and examples showing the results.

External services

MisticEase connects to YouTube and Vimeo to retrieve video thumbnails and titles, and when visitors click to play videos.

Terms and privacy policies:

  • YouTube Terms: https://www.youtube.com/t/terms
  • Google Privacy Policy: https://policies.google.com/privacy
  • Vimeo Privacy Policy: https://vimeo.com/privacy

Freemius

MisticEase uses the Freemius SDK for MisticEase Arc upgrades, trials, and purchases, and to prevent MisticEase and MisticEase Arc from being active simultaneously.

Opting in is optional. If you opt in, basic account, site, and environment information is shared with Freemius for product improvement and support. All MisticEase features work without opting in.

Privacy Policy: https://freemius.com/privacy/
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate MisticEase from the WordPress Plugins screen.
  2. Paste a supported video URL into a post or page and publish.
sections.faq:
Do I need to write shortcodes or embed code?

No. Paste a supported video URL and publish. Both the Block Editor and Classic Editor are supported.

Can I move popups on a phone?

At window widths of 640 px or less, videos open in a normal popup. Floating mode is available on larger screens.

Does MisticEase create separate cached thumbnail files for different display widths?

MisticEase keeps cached thumbnails at their standard size instead of generating separate files for each display width. Their displayed size adjusts responsively to the specified width or available space. This helps prevent unnecessary growth of the thumbnail cache folder.

Are thumbnails and popups fully responsive?

Yes. With or without a specified width, both thumbnails and popups fit within the available space.

Where can I find the full instructions?

Open the Readme tab in the MisticEase settings panel after installation.
